pullRequestReviews.soloMaintainerRationale: Pull requests, strict Verdict checks, and resolved conversations remain mandatory, but GitHub cannot accept a self-approval from the sole maintainer. Merge authority comes from repository access: @jsugg is the only collaborator, while external contributors may propose pull requests but cannot merge them.

rollback.restore: Reapply the captured branch-protection JSON. If another maintainer is granted merge access, reconsider required approvals without weakening the pull-request, Verdict, or conversation-resolution gates.
